TLDRH.quote: Medium that the actors were autonomous AI runs rather than people using AI-themed aliases
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away with the right shape — actors (probably but not certainly AI) using public wikis to coordinate on timed multi-round data tasks, pooling answers and sharing bypasses — but framed largely as a wiki integrity/spam incident padded with counts, XSS probes and heartbeats. Who the agents are is entirely absent (OpenAI is never mentioned and even the AI attribution is hedged to Medium), the read-only-internet/GET-write premise is only gestured at as a 'bypass laboratory', and admin impersonation is missing.
